items.title: Jane Ira Bloom interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 3, 1998
items.q: It was quite wonderful to work with him.

ctx.x: Sometimes you have to mark it yourself with the director. You have to go through the cues, and kind of figure out where is the most effective place for music, and that’s a learning process too, and each director has their own feel for that that you have to sort of work with.
You did a film with — Brian Dennehy was in that?

Yeah. He has a tremendous gift for music. He sat down and he knew exactly where the musical energy should be and where it should be directed. It was quite wonderful to work with him. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
